title: Sunrise Waves Layered Plaque
description: Paper-cut style wall art: a sun rising behind six stacked rolling waves in a framed plaque. Every layer steps up in 1 mm layers - friendly for multicolour printing.
use: Wall art / shelf decoration. Keyhole hangers on the back.
material: PLA, 0.2 mm layers; pause for colour changes at 5, 6.5, 7.5, 8.5, 9.5 mm or paint afterwards.
